note: AI6-T8 meeting-notes evaluation. Each case is a short, made-up meeting transcript (no real people or data) with the decisions and action items a competent note-taker would list, each written as the terms its text must contain, and the model output recorded for it. `ai6_eval_notes_recall` replays the recorded outputs through `parse_notes` (no live model) and fails when fewer than 80% of the expected action items are found. Re-record `recorded_output` from a real model when `meeting.notes` changes prompt version.
